newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil new soybean crop sales reach 18 pct -Safras.
newsitem.headline: Brazil new soybean crop sales reach 18 pct -Safras.

text.p: Brazilian soybean producers have sold forward around 4.73 million tonnes or 18 percent of the 1996/97 crop by November 21, independent consultants Safras e Mercado said in its weekly report.
This compares with 13 percent by November 23 last year and an historical average of 16 percent, it added.
It also however compares with 15 percent by mid-October this year and underlines producers' reluctance to sell at the current time due to international world prices, Safras said.
Based on planting intentions, Brazil's 1996/97 soybean crop should reach 26.38 million tonnes, Safras said.
PARANA - large volume negotiated, with emphasis on exports. Around 1,000 tonnes already thought to have been committed overseas.
RIO GRANDE DO SUL - very low volume sold so far, again ost commitments are for export market

MATO GROSSO - large amount already committed, much of which is either in exchange for inputs or has been done in the form of green bean sales (cash payment for delivery in March/April/May) or when buyers have taken on loan repayments
MATO GROSSO DO SUL - moderate sales, also involving exchanges or green beans sales
GOIAS- likewise moderate sales, mainly with the buyer taking over financial commitments
-- Caroline Bulloch, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 5074151
